description: This Python script sets up a voice interaction pipeline using Pipecat framework, involving speech activity detection, LLM interaction, and client connection handling for a Gemini Live LLM service.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents a sequence of processing steps for the voice interaction pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with its parameters and timeout settings.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Holds configuration options for a pipeline, such as metrics and usage tracking.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of a pipeline, including handling signals and running tasks.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract class for transport mechanisms handling input/output streams.

classes.name: GeminiLiveLLMService
classes.description: Client for interacting with the Gemini Live LLM API.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Maintains context for LLM interactions, including conversation history.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Handles aggregation of LLM context and responses.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the voice interaction pipeline with a specified transport.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the pipeline.
